prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: festive string lights glowing soft in the background bokeh while, in sharp foreground focus, shrimp hit a hot pan with garlic and sizzle violently. The camera follows lemon zest falling over the shrimp, then a vibrant salad being tossed high — leaves, cucumber ribbons, feta. Money shot: the garlic shrimp piled over the salad, pan juices drizzled over, steam backlit, macro on the glistening shrimp curl. Final beat: the bright plate against the warm festive glow. Deep shadows, warm 3200K, film grain. Dominant sound: the shrimp sizzle, then the leaves tossing. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
